name: chronelle
description: A connected platform for the people, places, plans, and memories that make up a life.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @chronelle/schemas build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/db build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/authorization build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/object-model build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/api build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/web build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @chronelle/schemas build && pnpm --filter @chronelle/object-model build && pnpm --parallel --filter @chronelle/api --filter @chronelle/web dev
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @chronelle/schemas test && pnpm --filter @chronelle/db test && pnpm --filter @chronelle/authorization test && pnpm --filter @chronelle/object-model test && pnpm --filter @chronelle/api test && pnpm --filter @chronelle/web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @chronelle/schemas typecheck && pnpm --filter @chronelle/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @chronelle/authorization typecheck && pnpm --filter @chronelle/object-model typecheck && pnpm --filter @chronelle/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @chronelle/web typecheck
